guards.rule: Ordinary editing has no plan/contract approval permit. Path and permission safety remain runtime invariants.

merge_gate.rule: The installed helper consumes exact GitHub PR head/base and current trusted Required / CI results, refuses outstanding GitHub change requests or unresolved review threads, scans credential/private paths and seals the immutable candidate. The publication merge executor merges only when publication.acceptance_merge is "on" in the policy at the PR base SHA and default-branch protection meets its preconditions (strict required status checks, enforce_admins, no merge queue); its threshold is the readiness verdict plus the closing-reference check. No external review, waiver, plan or AcceptanceReceipt is a merge permit.
